create_masked_vocab_builder: create a MaskedVocabBuilder instance that extends VocabBuilder with mask token support enabled
generate_tree_masked_source_target: generate masked source and target token sequences from an intent slot tree using TreeMask
generate_mask_everything_source_target: generate fully masked source and target token sequences where all tokens are replaced with mask tokens
generate_randomized_masked_source_target: generate source and target sequences with a random number of tokens replaced by mask tokens
generate_noop_masked_source_target: generate unmasked source tokens and corresponding target sequences using NoOpMaskingFunction for passthrough
